mainText: The United States and Denmark reached an agreement regarding Greenland's security.
President Trump banned media outlets CNN, MSNBC, and Politico from White House access.
Warren Buffett stepped down as head of Berkshire Hathaway after six decades.
An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent appeared in a Minnesota court to face charges related to a shooting involving a Venezuelan immigrant.
Russia is holding a parliamentary election over three days.
